rows.section: The universal enterprise-software pattern (present in EVERY category above)
rows.label: A visual, no-code builder
rows.detail: as the primary authoring surface (workflow/journey/dashboard/page/report canvas).

rows.section: The universal enterprise-software pattern (present in EVERY category above)
rows.label: A rules/automation engine
rows.detail: (trigger → condition → action) with a template library.

rows.section: The universal enterprise-software pattern (present in EVERY category above)
rows.label: An agentic AI layer
rows.detail: — every single vendor in every single category now ships (a) a conversational copilot, (b) generative authoring (NL → app/flow/email/report), and (c) autonomous multi-step **agents** with governance/guardrails. MCP + Google A2A are the emerging interop standards; most are LLM-agnostic/BYO-model.

rows.section: The universal enterprise-software pattern (present in EVERY category above)
rows.label: A unified data layer / semantic model
rows.detail: — CDP (marketing/analytics), Data Fabric (BPM/ServiceNow), Employee Graph (HR), semantic layer (BI), Customer 360 (CRM/commerce). "Define-once, use-everywhere" governed data is the strategic moat.

rows.section: The universal enterprise-software pattern (present in EVERY category above)
rows.label: A large pre-built integration marketplace + open REST/GraphQL APIs + webhooks
rows.detail: — connector counts (300–8,000+) are an explicit marketing axis.

rows.section: The universal enterprise-software pattern (present in EVERY category above)
rows.label: Enterprise governance baseline
rows.detail: — SAML SSO, SCIM, RBAC, audit logs, data residency, SOC 2 / ISO 27001 / GDPR / HIPAA.

rows.section: The universal enterprise-software pattern (present in EVERY category above)
rows.label: Tiered pricing (free/entry → pro → enterprise/custom)
rows.detail: with the AI/agentic/governance features gated to the top tiers.

rows.section: The universal enterprise-software pattern (present in EVERY category above)
rows.label: The generational shift every incumbent is racing toward
rows.detail: from human-operated software → to **agent-operated software**. Outcome-based pricing (pay-per-resolution, Intercom Fin / Zendesk) is the leading edge of this in support; agentic commerce ("Commerce for Agents," Agentforce) and agentic finance (Ramp/Brex AI agents) are the same move in their categories. **A platform that is agent-native from the ground up — where the graph IS the app and agents author + operate it — leapfrogs the bolt-on-AI incumbents.** That is precisely the base-studio-code thesis.
